notes: English synopsis: The page continues an account of a connected covering in terms of a subgroup Pi0-prime and its coset set. It states a conjugacy condition for a lift and describes possible choices using a transporter and a quotient by Pi0-prime. A left marginal explanation follows the stabilizer of the image of the chosen point; a right marginal caveat discusses outer versus ordinary endomorphisms. Another left marginal argument is canceled. The final paragraph applies the discussion to étale fundamental groupoids of a finite étale cover and stops at “des plus”.

No author page number is visible. Thin gray 93 at lower left is archive foliation in another unnamed hand. It is transcribed as a margin number and inventoried, without a substantive comparison row against H’s page identification.

Displays (47), (48), and (49) are present; (48 bis) occurs within the canceled note. A separate semicolon-like mark beside (48) is retained with doubt. There is no independent geometric drawing or commutative diagram: curved strokes here are an underbrace, marginal boundaries, insertion connections, and cancellations.

Source slips are preserved: plain Theta before (49), unprimed Pi0 in the final right-multiplier membership, and the unclosed parenthesis in the homogeneous-space note. No missing tilde, prime, or closing parenthesis is supplied.

Both barred field subscripts in the final application are definitely canceled. Their underlying k/K case and the case of the live unbarred field label remain unresolved. No field normalization was made from context.

The short crossed row above the longer Si… note is newly retained tentatively as pts plus two unreadable words. The long canceled note is only partly legible; all surviving tentative readings remain marked, including mathematical fragments. Its clearer final formula is transcribed without using it to repair the live argument.

Reader/root distinction: The independent first pass found capital Pi, ornate C, the underbrace, the point-label doubt, the separate punctuation beside (48), the canceled field subscripts, and the extra raised word. Root separately confirmed these features. Reinspection of the already made upper-margin crop after root’s message supported Or, où, and vaut. Root also agreed to keep the final raised word as inserted doubtful endom without a supplied point.

Mathematical scope: This report is a transcription and collation, not a proof of the lifting statements. Root separately reported a conditional stabilizer/transporter proof and a counterexample to unrestricted right Pi0 action, identifying the normalizer as the full right multiplier group when the transporter is nonempty. Those are root check events, not events claimed here; this reader’s check_events is empty.

Final punctuation correction before freezing: reinspection of the existing autom crop shows no separate period after the final m. The proposal now reads autom, and this is a substantive punctuation correction to both witnesses rather than a certainty-only decision.

Final canceled-note refinement: at root’s suggestion the existing canceled-margin crop was reused to inspect a separate E0-like symbol just before the existential line. Doubtful E0 is now explicit; its attachment to the surrounding unreadable prose is not reconstructed. The short preliminary crossed row remains low confidence, while the recovered final formula is medium confidence overall.
